A-C.evidence: Turn 9 C says she can't do the analysis and her own section isn't finished; A (turn 10) takes the work on and tells C to focus on their own parts, which fits C's position.

A-D.evidence: D asks how to handle it (4); A offers to finish the section (10, 12) and D thanks A (13, 42). A says 'Go. Be with your family' (51).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take on D's work (6, 9) and both accept A taking it (10-11), but they never address each other.

B-D.evidence: B never speaks to D. B accepts A's plan with 'Okay' (11), which D also accepts, but there is no direct exchange.

C-D.evidence: C says she can't do D's analysis (9) and never addresses D. Both end up accepting A's plan.
